headline: Turkey Completes Ratification of Makkah Joint Defence Agreement
summary: Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan formally approved the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement with Pakistan and Saudi Arabia, completing ratification.
why: Multilateral defense pacts among strategic regional powers influence geopolitical stability and international relations in the Middle East and South Asia.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Formalizes trilateral defense cooperation between Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan.
